name: Factory Training | Industry Sample
elevatorPitch: Factory Training is a high-fidelity URP demo showcasing scalable factory environments with GPU instancing, mixed lighting, custom shaders, and an interactive, step-by-step assembly workflow.
description:
Factory Training is a high-fidelity URP sample demonstrating how to create scalable, performance-focused industrial environments in Unity.


Explore an interactive factory featuring optimized rendering techniques, advanced materials, and a step-by-step robot assembly experience designed around real-world training and visualization workflows.


Core Features:

  • High-fidelity factory training environment
  • GPU instancing for repeated assets
  • Mixed lighting workflow
  • Custom optimized URP shaders
  • Multi-UV and tiled texture support
  • Mask-based material blending
  • Custom dirt and ambient occlusion maps
  • Interactive step-by-step robot assembly
  • Performance-focused environment setup
  • WebGPU support

Want to try the demo?

Try the WebGPU version on Unity Play here


WebGPU:

To run the WebGPU build locally, use a supported WebGPU-enabled browser and compatible hardware with up-to-date graphics drivers.


Compatibility:

  • Made for Unity 6.3
  • Uses the Universal Render Pipeline (URP)

Licensing:

All the assets can be repurposed and added to your own projects. Review the full licence for usage and redistribution terms: Unity Companion License
